name: Acute Osteomyelitis in Children
definition: Acute hematogenous bacterial infection of bone in children, commonly affecting metaphyseal regions of long bones.

investigations.principle: Inflammatory markers, blood cultures and MRI are central when diagnosis is uncertain or complications are suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Abscess or failure to respond may require surgical drainage.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-Shotha framework is secondary to antimicrobial management.

patientEducation.summary: Acute hematogenous bacterial infection of bone in children, commonly affecting metaphyseal regions of long bones.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
